scientific_integrity: Acyclic matching and exact integer Morse differential are reproduced by the included standalone Python verifier; literature comparisons distinguish prior rational homology from integral homotopy. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Exact ordinary integral homotopy type of a single finite complex only; no general K_{m,n} or equivariant statement. Full text of motivating recent preprint was inaccessible, which leaves an originality risk.
title: A mixed-dimensional sphere wedge for the two-matching complex of \(K_{4,5}\)
